notes.title: V2.2 Patch
notes.content:
[b]After complaining about performance issues, excessive camera effects, translation, and intuitive gameplay, the 2.2 update will fix:[/b]
- Excessive camera noise
- English translation from Russian in many places
- Problems with passing
- Intuitive clarity
- Minor bugs
[u]Thank you to all the players for being with us.[/u]
